QA Smoke Test - 01 September 2026

Environment Value
Platform Android real device
Session Authenticated tester session
App version Not reported in supplied evidence
Runtime evidence QA-confirmed real-device result

Result - BUG CONFIRMED

Acceptance step Expected Actual Status
Search known POTD keyword Matching existing POTD item is returned consistently Existing keyword intermittently returns no result BUG
Repeat same search Same query returns stable data Result is inconsistent across attempts BUG

Video evidence

WhatsApp.Video.2026-09-01.at.13.14.30.mp4
Method Finding
Black-box Known search key intermittently fails to display its existing item.
Gray-box UI query/result state does not consistently match visible POTD data.
White-box
unSearch debounces 500 ms then fetches; request lifecycle has no cancellation/request identity, so an older response may overwrite a newer query response. Root cause still requires API/network correlation.
Confusion matrix Observed
True positive Valid query returns its matching POTD item when response is current
True negative Not exercised
False positive Not observed
False negative Confirmed: known existing key returns no result

Developer follow-up

  1. Capture /notification/broadcast request/response for failing and passing attempts using the same query.
  2. Prevent stale response overwrite with request cancellation or a latest-request identifier.
  3. Retest repeated same-keyword searches after the fix.

Conclusion: Search Pick of The Day is inconsistent; bug confirmed from real-device test evidence.
